Source: Core Rulebook, p. 310–311

When you give a Non-Player Character one of these spells, rename it and tweak its effects to suit your needs. Most spells are already customizable, allowing you to choose between status effects or damage types — you make this choice when you are designing your NPC.

For instance, you might give a creature Cursed Breath from the list below, choose ice damage and the slow status effect and rename it to Frozen Spear.

| SPELL | MP | TARGET | DURATION | |---|:-:|---|---| | Area Status | 20 | Special | Instantaneous | | Every enemy the NPC can see suffers (choose one: dazed, shaken, slow, weak). | | | | | Breath O | 5 | One creature | Instantaneous | | The NPC deals (HR + 10) (choose type) damage to the target. | | | | | Curse O | 5 | One creature | Instantaneous | | The target suffers (choose one: dazed, shaken, slow, weak). | | | | | Curse XL O | 10 | One creature | Instantaneous | | The target suffers (choose two: dazed, shaken, slow, weak). | | | | | Cursed Breath O | 10 | One creature | Instantaneous | | The NPC deals (HR + 15) (choose type) damage to the target, then the target suffers (choose one: dazed, shaken, slow, weak). | | | | | Devastation | 30 | Special | Instantaneous | | The NPC deals 30 (choose type) damage to every enemy they can see. This spell should only be given to champion and elite enemies level 30 or higher, which should only cast it during their last turn of the round, creating a predictable pattern that Players can anticipate. | | | | | Lick Wounds | 5 | Self | Instantaneous | | The NPC recovers 20 Hit Points. This amount increases to 30 Hit Points if the NPC is level 20 or higher, 40 Hit Points if they are level 40 or higher, or 50 Hit Points if they are level 60 or higher. | | | | | Life Theft O | 10 | One creature | Instantaneous | | The NPC deals (HR + 15) (choose type) damage to the target, then recovers an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Point loss suffered by the target. | | | | | Mind Theft O | 10 | One creature | Instantaneous | | The NPC deals (HR + 15) (choose type) damage to the target, then recovers an amount of Mind Points equal to half the total Hit Point loss suffered by the target. | | | | | Poison O | 10 × T | Up to three creatures | Instantaneous | | Each target hit by this spell suffers poisoned. | | | | | Quicken | 20 | One creature | Instantaneous | | The target may perform a free attack with a weapon they have equipped (or with a basic attack, if the target is an NPC). | | | | | Rage O | 10 × T | Up to three creatures | Instantaneous | | Each target hit by this spell suffers enraged. | | | | | Shell | 10 | Self | Scene | | Until this spell ends, the NPC gains Resistance to physical damage. | | | | | War Cry | 10 × T | Up to three creatures | Scene | | Until this spell ends, each target gains a +1 bonus to Accuracy Checks. | | | | | Weaken O | 10 | One creature | Scene | | Until this spell ends, sources that deal (choose type) damage deal 5 extra damage to the target. | | | |
